entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Smt. Mithlesh And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Satish Kumar Tyagi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,Tapan Kumar Mishra
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Present application has been preferred with the prayer to stay/quash the entire proceeding of Criminal Complaint no. 3548 of 2009 (Smt. Sadhana Jain vs. Jaibir Singh) under Section 406, 420,
467, 468 IPC pending in court of Judicial Magistrate (C.B.I. Ghaziabad) against the applicants.

entities.text: Criminal Complaint no. 3548 of 2009 (Smt. Sadhana Jain vs. Jaibir Singh)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. At the very outset, learned counsel for applicants submitted that no offence under Section 406,
420, 467, 468 IPC is made out against the applicants.

Opposite party no. 2 has filed a complaint against the applicants with malafide and malicious intention to fulfill her ulterior motive and only to Smt. Mithlesh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24527622/
1 harass the applicants.

entities.text: Mithlesh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the opposite party although vehemently opposed the prayer sought through the instant application but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

5. By bare perusal of the records, it is crystal clear that matter is pending before this Court since 2010 itself and nothing fruitful has been came up just over the interim protection which was granted in favour of the applicants by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 27.01.2011 at the admission stage.
6.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the concerned trial court is hereby directed to expedite and finalize the proceedings of the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of 6 months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order before him without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

7. Learned counsel for applicants assures on the behalf of the applicants that applicants will fully cooperate with the learned trial court concerned for expeditious disposal of the Criminal Complaint no. 3548 of 2009 (Smt. Sadhana Jain vs. Jaibir Singh).
8. However, it is made clear that till the disposal of the proceedings of the aforementioned criminal case, no coercive action shall be taken up against the applicants herein.
9. The instant Application U/S 482 stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Shaswat  Smt. Mithlesh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24527622/
